text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
TANKERS - Toyosu - (built 1984) 29,947 dwt sold for $25 million.
Federal Matane - (built 1984) 28,214 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $9.5 million including three plus one year timecharter, rate under negotiation.
Astipalea - (built 1970) 30,318 dwt sold for $2 million to Greek buyers.
BULKERS - Thalia - (built 1976) 30,694 dwt sold for $3.35 million to Greek buyers.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Negotiator - (built 1973) 16,617 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $170 per ldt.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
